The quadrotor and dock are CL-05 concept geometry (cad/params/common.yaml uav:). Flights are PX4 SITL output (SIH quadrotor over flat ground at the dock's level): synthetic, no evidence credit.
Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CAD = computer-aided design · CG = centre of gravity · CONOPS = concept of operations · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · EXT-AIRSPACE = external element: airspace, people and property under the UAV · EXT-GNSS-RF = external element: GNSS and RF environment · EXT-WEATHER = external element: weather · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · GNSS = global navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · MOD-nnn = operating mode from the CONOPS (MOD-01 to MOD-10) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · RAC = risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · RF = radio frequency · RTL = return to launch (a PX4 flight mode) · SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) · SIH = simulation-in-hardware, PX4's built-in headless simulator · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SPEC-nnn = simulation parameter spec record (sim/spec/) · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-CAD-001 = the concept layouts document (cad/README.md); its drawing sheets are SUS-CAD-001-CL-nn · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
